SYMPTOM: Tapping emoji button crashes keyboard extension; iOS falls back to native keyboard. Crash at EmojiKeyboardView.setupCollectionView() → NSLayoutConstraint setActive:

CAUSE: collectionView.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bottomBar.topAnchor) was activated before bottomBar was added as a subview. NSLayoutConstraint crashes when constraining to a view not yet in the hierarchy.

FIX: Reorder setup calls — call setupBottomBar() before setupCollectionView() so bottomBar exists when its anchor is referenced.

PREVENT: When setting up constraints between sibling views, always ensure both views are added to the hierarchy before activating their constraints. setupBottomBar() must be the first setup method called in EmojiKeyboardView.
